caption: The video captures a close, dark view dominated by a large red textured sphere with a matte surface and a band of bright specular sparkles across its mid-section. The sphere drifts steadily downward, its top edge sliding from the upper third toward the lower middle while its horizontal placement and apparent size stay roughly constant. As it descends, more of the swirling iridescent blue-violet pattern studded with droplet-like speckles is exposed above the sphere. The surrounding pattern changes around the descending sphere, while the upper-right glow remains near the corner. Bright speckles on the sphere and pattern flicker and reposition throughout. A soft greenish glow lingers in the upper-right corner throughout, its own speckles shifting slightly. The downward motion is already underway and continues without pause. No start or completion of the drift is visible.
